build_clevr_teacher: build a Parlai CLEVR DialogTeacher to load and serve visual reasoning questions with images
run_default_teacher: run the DefaultTeacher class to iterate over CLEVR dataset questions and answers by image episode
review_label_candidates: review the DefaultTeacher label_candidates method to get all possible CLEVR answer tokens
refactor_setup_data: refactor the setup_data method to customize how CLEVR questions and image paths are yielded per episode
summarize_path_function: summarize the _path function to resolve CLEVR questions and images file paths from the opt config
